about: Feron Poleon LLP works from Sweet Home Road in Amherst and was founded by two lawyers who were previously at Spadafora & Verrastro, Kelly A. Feron as a managing partner there and Katie M. Poleon as a senior associate. Both are named as founding partners on its own roster page.

35 reviews at 4.7. This firm was nearly left out of the ranking altogether: its site answers on its www host and refuses a connection on the bare domain, which read as a firm with no website until the crawler was taught to ask the other host. It explains four stages of a matrimonial case, publishes no structured data, and publishes no fee.

subs.evidence: Nothing about the rate, the retainer or any other price on the 4 pages we read. The court rules guarantee a client all of it in a signed agreement before the work starts; publishing it beforehand is the firm's choice
